ETOBJ_GNDT.TWB_TITLE: Test Data for BO Sales Order for Omni Channel Sales Promotion (LMD Cases)

item.CODE:
data: lo_access type ref to if_goal_access. data: ls_action type if_goal_types=>tcs_action. data: ls_head_data type tds_goal_so_head. data: lv_vbeln type vbeln_va.
data(ls_step_precessor) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = 1 ).
call method cl_goal_api=>so_instance->open exporting iv_bo_id = `SALESORDER` iv_bo_key = ls_step_precessor-document_id[ 1 ]-vbeln && `` receiving ro_access = lo_access.
call method lo_access->get_entity exporting iv_entity_id = `HEAD` importing es_entity_data = ls_head_data.
ls_action-action = `SET_OCSP_LOCK`. ls_action-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lo_access->do_action( exporting is_action = ls_action ).
lo_access->save( exporting iv_synchron = abap_true importing ev_bo_key = lv_vbeln ).
lo_access->close( ).
ev_immediate_exit = abap_false. rv_execution_status = abap_true.
item.DESCRIPTION: Set OCSP Lock -> Header status Locked Manually
